CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.danbi_acquire_lease(p_role text, p_owner text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v uuid;
begin
 if p_role not in ('compiler','builder','gate') or coalesce(length(p_owner),0)=0 then raise exception 'Invalid lease owner'; end if;
 insert into danbi_pipeline_leases as l(name,role,owner,token,expires_at)
 values('production',p_role,p_owner,gen_random_uuid(),now()+interval '20 minutes')
 on conflict(name) do update set role=excluded.role,owner=excluded.owner,
 token=case when l.owner=excluded.owner and l.role=excluded.role then l.token else excluded.token end,
 expires_at=excluded.expires_at
 where l.expires_at<=now() or (l.owner=excluded.owner and l.role=excluded.role)
 returning token into v;
 return v;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.danbi_assert_lease(p_role text, p_token uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from danbi_pipeline_leases where name='production' and role=p_role and token=p_token and expires_at>now()) then raise exception 'Missing, expired or wrong-role lease'; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.danbi_release_lease(p_token uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ delete from danbi_pipeline_leases where name='production' and token=p_token $function$
